### Flow A - request (daily 11:00 Africa/Lagos)
Active users (status=active) 6-8 days after `signup_date`, not yet asked. Needs `FEEDBACK_FORM_URL`, Resend env vars.
### Flow B - collect
`POST /webhook/collect-feedback` + header `X-Eki-Webhook-Secret`.
`{ "email": "..", "rating": 1-5, "comments": "..", "would_recommend": true }`
Rating 4-5: thank-you (+ store review links if `APP_STORE_REVIEW_URL` / `PLAY_STORE_REVIEW_URL` set). 1-2: Telegram alert. No reward is promised unless `FEEDBACK_REWARD_TEXT` is set.
